messages:
olivia k: Quick bake kickoff — ran GPTQ on Llama-3-7b, Mistral-7b, Qwen-7b. Short summary in thread. TL;DR: Mistral shows numeric instability on AWQ-style group=128; GPTQ with group=256 looks stable but EM drop vs FP16 varies.

 tj: nice. what's the eval suite? squad/v0, mathqa, summarization rouge?

 olivia k: Eval sets: SQuAD v2 (F1/EM), MMLU subset, TruthfulQA short, SummEval (rougeL), and our internal regression prompts (1000 pairs).

 sasha: numbers?

 olivia k: Llama-3-7b GPTQ (g256, 4-bit per-tensor) vs FP16: SQuAD EM -0.8, F1 -1.3, MMLU -1.6, latency -28%, memory -62%.

 maya: Mistral-7b GPTQ (g256): SQuAD EM -2.9, weird hallucination rate +4%, but latency -35%. AWQ (g128 int8) showed catastrophic EM -8 on some QA samples.

 nate: Qwen-7b GPTQ (g128): SQuAD EM -0.5, MMLU -0.9, SummEval rougeL -0.6, latency -30%. KV cache size stable.

 eval-bot: Attached per-model regression diff for top-10 prompts: https://redwood-internal/reports/gptq-21793

 sasha: Any quant-specific tokenization or prompt prep changes? Temperature, stop sequences same?

 olivia k: No changes. Using same tokenization and decoding params. We suspect layernorm/rotary sensitivity on Mistral causing drift.

 tj: ```bash
python tools/run_gptq.py \
  --model models/mistral-7b-v0.1 \
  --method gptq \
  --group-size 256 \
  --bits 4 \
  --calib-samples 2048 \
  --out-dir /tmp/gptq-mistral
```

 sasha: Can we try per-channel vs per-tensor? Also try remap layernorm fp16.

 olivia k: Yes on deck. Next runs: GPTQ-g256 vs GPTQ-g32 and AWQ-int8(g128) with layernorm-cast True. Will post updated deltas.

 deploy-bot: Reminder: avoid shipping Mistral GPTQ to hosted until we pass regression gate (EM drop <1.5% across SQuAD and MMLU).

 maya: For Dedicated profiles, memory wins make GPTQ attractive for 3x concurrency. Proposed prod rollout plan: canary on Dedicated with fallback to FP16 in hosted via routing policy.

 nate: Also check KV cache correctness under continuous batching — saw 1/1000 token mismatch on Llama run earlier.

 olivia k: Noted. Adding KV cache smoke tests + end-to-end chat evals. Plan to update thread by EOD with new numbers.
